Class Order

java.lang.Object
app.order.Order
@Entity public class Order extends Object
A client's buy/sell instruction, tracked through its own status lifecycle (BR-04/05/06) — deliberately separate from execution, which lives in order.execution.Fill.

Lifecycle (see V001__Initial_schema.sql): SUBMITTED -> ACCEPTED/REJECTED -> FILLED/EXECUTION_FAILED. This entity is persisted as SUBMITTED the moment a request is received, before the trading-rule pipeline runs, so a rejected order still leaves a record.
